description: Seasonal production modifiers by item category. Multiplies base production_rate.

Spring.description: Planting season. Farms flourish, moderate output across the board.
events: Spring planting begins! Farms are extra productive.
The annual Spring Fair draws visitors to town.
Seed merchants offer discounts to farmers.

Summer.description: Peak growing season. Bountiful harvests, but some materials suffer in heat.
events: Harvest season! The fields are golden.
A heatwave wilts some crops but ripens fruit.

Autumn.description: Harvest festival. Materials stockpile, food production tapers.

Winter.description: Harsh conditions. Food production plummets, wood demand surges for heating.
events: Winter stores are full. The town is prepared.
A harsh blizzard isolates the town.
Ice blocks the river — fisheries halt.
